children: HNO International entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement and issued a $210,000 6% convertible redeemable note to CFI Capital, receiving $189,000 after a $21,000 original issue discount. The note matures Sep 04, 2027 and becomes convertible after six months at 60% of the lowest trading price over the prior 20 days, subject to adjustments. Conversions are capped at 4.99% beneficial ownership (increasable to 9.9% with notice), and the company reserved 49,295,775 shares for conversions with a 5x ongoing reserve requirement. The agreement includes a most-favored-nation provision on key economic terms.
